edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (as collected in the Quan Tang wen and the Guwen guanzhi).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《全唐文》《古文观止》所收）。

basis.en: Tang dynasty essay; the author died in 824.
basis.zh: 唐代散文，作者卒于 824 年。

note.en: Han Yu's short essay on why everyone needs a teacher, written around 802 for a seventeen-year-old student, Li Pan. It argues that the Way, not age or rank, decides who teaches whom. Notice the line that a disciple need not be lesser than the teacher: some simply heard the Way sooner.
note.zh: 韩愈约 802 年写给十七岁学生李蟠的短文，讲人为什么都需要老师。它主张决定谁做老师的是道，而不是年龄或地位。留意“弟子不必不如师”一句：只是闻道有先后。

excerpt.orig: 聞道有先後，術業有專攻，如是而已。
excerpt.en: Some hear the Way sooner and some later; each art and craft has its specialists. That is all there is to it.
excerpt.zh: 闻道有先后，术业有专攻，如是而已。
